usage: tr retrieval build [-h] --ticker TICKER [TICKER ...]
                          [--quarters QUARTERS] [--max-tokens MAX_TOKENS]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --ticker TICKER [TICKER ...]
  --quarters QUARTERS   look back this many 91-day quarters (default 4)
  --max-tokens MAX_TOKENS
                        chunk size cap (default 256)
